citations.A1: the cache has no invalidation — once `_cache` is set it is never compared against the file again; key the cache on the file's mtime
citations.A2: NOT a fix: a time-based TTL (re-read every N seconds) — it only shrinks the stale window instead of closing it
citations.A3: NOT a fix: adding a `reload=True` argument or a `clear_cache()` function — it moves the burden onto every call site
citations.A4: `path` is ignored after the first call — a second call with a different path silently returns the first file's data
citations.A5: Not thread-safe — two threads can enter the load block at once and double-read; guard the check-and-load with a `threading.Lock`
citations.A6: Mutable return value is shared — a caller mutating the returned dict corrupts every later caller's config; return a deep copy
citations.A8: `_cache is None` conflates "not loaded" with "loaded a falsy value" — a config file of `null` reloads on every call
